title: インテンシブイングリッシュ
subtitle: Intensive English
courseType:
English Language Program
English Language Courses
educationalGoal: This program prepares participants to become engineers in a global society in the following ways: 1. Students are expected to improve their English communication skills by using English outside of the classroom. 2. By working with classmates from various cultural backgrounds, students will improve their ability to think globally, gain cooperation and leadership skills, and appreciate diversity. 3. Learn how to communicate even when there are linguistic or cultural barriers. 4. Make a presentation in English about their experience after returning to Japan.
advice: This is a short-term study abroad program. Students will take English courses at KIT partner schools in New Zealand and England over a 3-4 week period. Course contents will vary depending on the school. Detailed information will be provided during the application process / at the program orientation. During the program, students are expected to take the initiative to interact positively in English with those around them.
requiredKnowledge: Knowledge of basic English grammar and vocabulary are necessary.
